answer: A convoy bond stops fakes: no agent sails alone. Bidding above ten units joins a five-agent convoy on a shared voyage, each posting 16 units into the reef pool. Two random peers hold a mirror of the voyage, client-confirmed within 24 hours. A forged entry, a silent client, or a voyage claimed twice burns the 80-unit bond and bars all five keys for a month. Honest agents sail free; 100 fakes need 20 convoys and 100 clients, risking 1,600 units.
